source: A nonlinear state estimation framework for humanoid robots
translation: 人形机器人非线性状态估计框架

source: This article proposes a novel nonlinear state estimation framework for humanoid robots based on the dynamics of the center of mass (CoM) and dual-loop Kalman filter (DLKF). It fuses IMU, joint encoder, and foot FSR information; uses DLKF to compensate for non-zero-mean, non-Gaussian, correlated process errors; uses IEKF for floating-base kinematics; and reports improved CoM/DCM accuracy in simulation.
translation: 本文提出一种基于质心动力学和双环卡尔曼滤波器的人形机器人非线性状态估计框架，融合 IMU、关节编码器和足底 FSR 信息，以 DLKF 补偿过程误差，并用 IEKF 估计浮动基座运动学。仿真结果显示，该框架提高了 CoM 和 DCM 的估计精度。
notes: 摘要记录为段落级概述；完整译文保留原摘要全部限定信息。

source: Robust and stable gait generation is vital for humanoid robots. Whole-body-dynamics gait generation is impractical because humanoid robots are high-dimensional, nonlinear, and hybrid. Existing simplified models include LIPM, SLIP, capture point and DCM approaches, which require real-time CoM position and often velocity feedback.
translation: 稳健、稳定的步态生成对人形机器人至关重要。由于人形机器人具有高维、非线性和混杂等特征，采用全身动力学生成步态并不实用。已有简化模型包括 LIPM、SLIP、捕获点和 DCM 方法，均需要实时 CoM 位置反馈，其中不少还需要速度反馈。
notes: 段落按引言论证单元对齐。

source: State estimation first requires floating-base kinematics estimation, followed by CoM state estimation. Prior work includes Q-EKF, IEKF, and simplified-model KF estimators; linear and compliant inverted-pendulum models have limitations in CoM height, plane coupling, external-force handling, and model error.
translation: 状态估计首先需要估计浮动基座运动学，随后估计 CoM 状态。既有方法包括 Q-EKF、IEKF 和基于简化模型的 KF 估计器；线性和柔顺倒立摆模型在 CoM 高度、平面耦合、外力处理及模型误差方面存在局限。
notes: 对应引言中先前工作的综述段。

source: The proposed framework fuses IMU, encoder and FSR information, uses nonlinear CoM dynamics with DLKF, and applies IEKF to floating-base kinematics without requiring a force/torque sensor.
translation: 本文框架融合 IMU、编码器和 FSR 信息，以非线性 CoM 动力学结合 DLKF，并用 IEKF 估计浮动基座运动学，无需使用力/力矩传感器。

section: 2.1 人形机器人的非线性动力学
source: The Newton–Euler equations describe humanoid-robot dynamics using CoM acceleration, ground contact forces, external force, and angular momentum rate.
translation: 本文用牛顿–欧拉方程描述人形机器人动力学，涉及 CoM 加速度、地面接触力、外力和角动量变化率。

source: A conventional EKF assumes zero-mean Gaussian uncorrelated process error. DLKF adds a disturbance-estimation KF loop to estimate the process error in real time and compensate model error.
translation: 传统 EKF 假设过程误差为零均值、高斯且不相关。DLKF 增加扰动估计 KF 环路，实时估计过程误差并补偿模型误差。

source: The framework estimates CoM state through floating-base kinematics estimation followed by CoM-state estimation.
translation: 该框架通过先估计浮动基座运动学、再估计 CoM 状态来获得 CoM 状态估计。

source: IEKF exploits group-affine properties on matrix Lie groups to obtain linear error propagation with a nonlinear process model. FSR measurements detect the contact foot using a force threshold.
translation: IEKF 利用矩阵李群上的群仿射性质，在非线性过程模型下实现线性误差传播。通过 FSR 测量及力阈值检测接触足。

source: The CoM estimator state comprises CoM position, velocity, and external force. Inputs include ZMP position, vertical ground-contact force, and angular-momentum rate. Measurements include CoM position and acceleration.
translation: CoM 估计器状态包括 CoM 位置、速度和外力；输入包括 ZMP 位置、垂直接触力和角动量变化率；测量量包括 CoM 位置与加速度。

source: The framework is evaluated in Simscape Multibody because accurate robot ground truth is difficult to measure in real environments. The study compares CoM/DCM estimators and simulates the full framework.
translation: 由于真实环境中难以准确测得机器人真实状态，本文在 Simscape Multibody 虚拟环境中验证框架，比较 CoM/DCM 估计器并仿真完整框架。

source: Nonlinear dynamics plus DLKF is compared with nonlinear dynamics plus EKF and linear-model KF/DLKF baselines. The nonlinear DLKF approach has the best RMSE; the nonlinear model contributes more to accuracy than DLKF alone.
translation: 本文比较非线性动力学 + DLKF、非线性动力学 + EKF 以及线性模型 KF/DLKF。非线性 DLKF 方法的 RMSE 最低；非线性模型对精度的贡献大于单独使用 DLKF。

source: IEKF estimates floating-base kinematics, but unobservable base position causes integration drift and eventual divergence. CoM estimates are initially accurate and then diverge with the base estimate.
translation: IEKF 估计浮动基座运动学，但基座位置不可观测会导致积分漂移并最终发散。CoM 估计初期较准确，之后随基座估计一同发散。

source: The proposed nonlinear CoM dynamics and DLKF estimator improves prediction and CoM/DCM state accuracy. Future work will address unobservable base position and yaw using additional sensors and improve contact detection.
translation: 本文提出的非线性 CoM 动力学与 DLKF 估计器提高了预测和 CoM/DCM 状态估计精度。未来将使用额外传感器处理基座位置和偏航角不可观测问题，并改进接触检测。
